title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：pocket　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pocket 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the tailor ① emptyed the pocket that no customer in the shop would have described, and he said the emptying was the whole of the week. The ② pocket, meaning the bag itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a pocket, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ pocket in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ pocket at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pocket, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the tailor said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pocket was the whole of the matter, meaning the secret and not the bag. The ⑥ pocket, meaning the secret and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; pocket, he said, is either something you empty or the only word that means both a bag and a secret. He said the secret is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ pocket had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ pocket of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of describing; pocket, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pocket I remember is the bag described in the order, which closed in 1989 and is still described as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ pocket, my mother said in 1991, is the only bag that improves by being described; every pocket, she said, is a secret that has agreed to look like a bag. She said the secret was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 口袋（指裁缝铺里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 口袋（指那个口袋本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：empty the pocket 掏空这一个口袋
D. n. 口袋（指留给孩子们补的那一道）

F. n. 口袋（指订单簿里写到、被描述的那一个）
G. n. 口袋、私房（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: empty the pocket 意为“掏空这一个口袋”，1982 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯描述的一个口袋做了一遍。
pocket 意为“口袋”，指那个口袋本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
pocket 意为“口袋”，指裁缝铺里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
pocket 意为“口袋”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pocket 意为“口袋、私房”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个私房就是那件事的全部。
pocket 意为“私房”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个口袋，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pocket 意为“口袋”，指订单簿里写到、被描述的那一个，到 1987 年这一个成了订单簿里的一行。
pocket 意为“口袋之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的口袋之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的描述。
pocket 意为“口袋”，我记得的是订单簿里描述过的那一个，1989 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一个。
pocket 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，口袋是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的口袋。
